definition.text: The Exxon Valdez oil spill was a major environmental disaster in Prince William Sound, Alaska, on March 24, 1989.

facts.text: The supertanker Exxon Valdez struck Bligh Reef and spilled more than 10 million US gallons of crude oil over the next few days.
It was the first case where contingent valuation surveys were used in a quantitative assessment of damages, and use of the technique spread from there.
Existence values were part of the legal damage assessment after the spill.
An Anchorage jury awarded $287 million in actual damages and $5 billion in punitive damages, which an appeals court ordered reduced.

title: Latent class model

definition.text: A latent class model is a statistical model that sorts multivariate discrete data into hidden groups, or classes.

facts.text: It assumes the data come from a mixture of distributions, with the variables independent within each class.
It is called latent because each data point's class is not observed.
For example, answers to a political questionnaire could reveal latent classes corresponding to political groups.

notes: The page never mentions choice modelling or valuation; its use to find preference groups in choice experiments is not covered by the dossier.

definition.text: Meta-regression is a meta-analysis that uses regression to combine and compare findings from many studies while adjusting for study characteristics.

facts.text: It aims to reconcile conflicting studies or confirm consistent ones.
Fixed-effect versions assume the studies do not really differ, while mixed-effect versions allow for variation between studies and are often the most flexible choice.
It has been applied to the value of a statistical life, energy and water policy, and price elasticities for water and energy.
It is increasingly used to weigh evidence across many cost-benefit studies of a policy or programme.

definition.text: Mixed logit is a fully general statistical model for analysing discrete choices, in which tastes are allowed to vary randomly between people.

facts.text: It overcomes three limits of standard logit: it allows random taste variation, unrestricted substitution patterns, and correlation in unobserved factors over time.
Unlike standard logit, it does not impose the restrictive independence of irrelevant alternatives property.
With suitable specification it can approximate any random utility model of discrete choice to any accuracy.
Its choice probability has no closed form, so it must be estimated by simulation, drawing repeatedly from the taste distribution.
